# Adventure Park Rishikesh

> Adventure activities and stays in Shivpuri, Rishikesh (Uttarakhand, India): river rafting on the Ganga, bungee jumping from 109 m, zip line, luxury camps & cottages with three meals a day, and hotel rooms. Founded in 2006 by Jagat Singh Bhandari (JSB). Tagline: "Where Rishikesh gets wild". Safety first, always.

Key facts:

- Founder: Jagat Singh Bhandari (JSB) — 25+ years of experience, more than 5 lakh people served; Adventure Park has run since 2006.
- Location: Near Shiv Mandir, Badrinath Highway, Shivpuri, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/CKrMGT2h8CRNrcmi6
- Phone: +91 97623 88871, +91 87555 42743 (also WhatsApp: https://wa.me/918755542743)
- Email: adventurepark661@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/adventure_park771/
- All prices are in Indian rupees (INR, ₹), per person unless stated.
- Booking: send a booking request; the team confirms availability and the total price; the booking is confirmed once a 50% advance is paid by UPI. The remaining 50% is paid at Adventure Park.

## Activities and prices

- River rafting (with an experienced guide on every raft):
  - 12 km, Marine Drive → Shivpuri, about 1–1.5 hours: ₹520 per person
  - 16 km, Shivpuri → Nim Beach, about 1.5–2 hours: ₹720 per person
  - 26 km, Marine Drive → Nim Beach, about 2–2.5 hours: ₹1,200 per person
  - 36 km, Kaudiyala → Nim Beach, about 2.5–3 hours: ₹2,400 per person
  - Peak season (March–June): weekends and crowded days cost 15–20% more.
- Bungee jumping: 109 m (360 ft), ₹4,000 per person, including a DSLR video of the jump and a jump certificate.
- Zip line: ₹1,800 per person for students, ₹2,000 per person for adults.
- Other adventure activities: available on request — contact the team for details and prices.

## Booking and payment

1. Send a booking request on the [Booking page](https://adventureprk.netlify.app/booking.html) (each activity and stay on the home page has its own "Book" button), or call / WhatsApp.
2. The team confirms availability and the total price.
3. Pay a 50% advance by UPI to confirm the booking: scan the QR code on the [Booking page](https://adventureprk.netlify.app/booking.html#pay) with PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM or any UPI app. UPI ID: 8755542743@ybl, payee name: M/S ADVENTURE PARK. Example: for a ₹4,000 bungee jump, the advance is ₹2,000.
4. Send the payment screenshot on WhatsApp (+91 87555 42743). The booking is confirmed once the advance is received.
5. The remaining 50% is paid at Adventure Park.

## Stay

- Luxury camps & cottages, 200 m up from the river and 100 m up from the national highway (not riverside):
  - Quad or triple sharing: ₹1,500–₹1,800 per person per night
  - Double sharing: ₹1,800–₹2,200 per person per night
  - Children aged 6–11 pay 50% of the adult price; the exact price depends on the season and weekend demand.
  - Included: three meals a day, swimming pool, DJ party until 10 pm, attached washroom, fan, charging points. Non-AC camps have an air cooler; AC cottages have air conditioning.
- Hotel rooms (room only — meals, pool and DJ party are not included):
  - Non-AC room: ₹1,200 per room per night (busy days ₹1,600–₹1,800)
  - AC room: ₹1,600 per room per night (busy days ₹2,000–₹2,200)

## Food (included with camp and cottage stays)

- **Breakfast** (Served 8:30 – 10:00 AM): Hot drinks: Masala tea, coffee, milk; Main dishes: Aloo or gobhi parathas with butter, dahi and pickle, or puri bhaji; Continental & light: Eggs to order (omelette, boiled or scrambled), bread toast with butter and jam, poha or veg upma
- **Buffet lunch** (Served 1:30 – 3:00 PM · 100% pure vegetarian): Main veg curry: Matar paneer / Shahi paneer / Kadhai paneer; Dry veg: Mix veg / Jeera aloo / Bhindi fry; Dal: Dal tadka / Yellow dal fry; Rice & breads: Steamed basmati rice / Jeera rice, tawa roti / chapati; Sides: Green salad, boondi raita, papad, mixed pickle
- **Evening snacks** (Served 6:00 – 7:30 PM): Snacks: Hot veg pakoras (paneer, aloo or mix veg) or French fries; Drinks: Masala tea and coffee; Optional add-on: Live BBQ: chicken tikka and paneer tikka, for groups who request it in advance
- **Buffet dinner** (Served 8:30 – 10:30 PM): Non-veg main: Chicken curry / Kadhai chicken / Butter chicken; Veg main: Kadhai paneer / Palak paneer / Dum aloo; Dal: Dal makhani / Panchmel dal; Rice & breads: Peas pulao / Veg biryani, fresh tawa roti; Sides & dessert: Green salad, papad, pickle; gulab jamun / kheer / sewaiyan

## Safety

Every activity starts with a safety briefing, uses equipment inspected before each use (helmets, life jackets, harnesses) and is led by experienced guides. Weather and river conditions are checked, and trips are rescheduled when conditions aren't safe.

## FAQ

- **Do I need any experience?** Not at all. Many of our activities are beginner friendly, and our team will recommend the right ones for you when you book.
- **How do you keep guests safe?** Every activity starts with a safety briefing, uses equipment that's inspected before each use and is led by experienced guides. If the weather or river conditions aren't safe, we reschedule.
- **Are there age or health requirements?** Some activities have age, weight or health requirements. Share your details when you book and we'll tell you what's suitable for everyone in your group.
- **Do prices change in peak season?** Yes. From March to June, rafting costs 15–20% more on weekends and crowded days, and camping and hotel prices rise with demand. We confirm the exact price when you book.
- **Are there lower prices for children or students?** Children aged 6–11 pay half the adult price for camping, and students pay ₹1,800 instead of ₹2,000 for the zip line.
- **How do I book and pay?** Send a booking request first. Our team confirms availability and the total price, then you pay a 50% advance by UPI to confirm your booking: scan the QR code on the Booking page with PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm or any UPI app (UPI ID 8755542743@ybl, name M/S Adventure Park) and send us the payment screenshot on WhatsApp. The remaining 50% is paid at Adventure Park.
- **What should I bring?** Comfortable clothes, sturdy shoes, sunscreen and a change of clothes for water activities. We'll share a full list for your activities when you book.
- **When is the best time to visit?** It depends on the activity, as river activities are seasonal. Ask us when you book and we'll suggest the best dates for your trip.
